scope_entries.finding: Upgrading 4 gateways (cultureos 0.93.0, spark2 0.89.2, orin 0.89.0; thor on 0.92.0.dev694) to 0.94.0 took one hand-written SSH script per box; Claude Code's auto-mode blocked remote writes, so the operator ran each script

0.94.0 merged 2026-11-04 but never reached PyPI: the test job hit 'No space left on device' and publish was skipped; nobody noticed for 5 days. After the rerun published it, pip inside python:3.12-slim still could not resolve lobes-cli==0.94.0 for several minutes (CDN lag), so the first gateway build failed

The gateway takes an explicit environment: list, never env_file. spark2's hand-kept 0.89-era compose lacked STT_EN_BASE_URL/STT_EN_FEASIBLE, so after upgrading to 0.94.0 the stt-en lane was silently infeasible until four lines were added to docker-compose.override.yml
Exits non-zero while gateway_version_match FAILs, which is the very skew it is about to fix; a set -e upgrade script stopped there on spark2
Single-box re-image path that works; a failed build leaves the old gateway running (safe). It does not wait for health or verify capabilities

#262: fleet up starts nothing when MODEL_GEAR_VERSION is unpublished (overlaps the preflight need). #198 'mass-update' is rollout-cli's cross-REPO code propagation, not box deployment; no existing fleet-rollout issue

GET /mesh/roster lists every member (name, origin, verified, roles) but carries NO version; each gateway's own unauthenticated GET /health returns {"version": ...} (issue #99), and /capabilities gives the per-role served state, so roster + per-member /health + /capabilities together give the before/after diff for verification
